game.name: Update Proton CachyOS
game.desc: Updates the Proton-CachyOS (ARM64) Steam compatibility tools in place, without re-running the full "Install Steam" routine. CachyOS ships two release lines (10.x and 11.x); this keeps the latest of BOTH installed side by side, so a new proton-10 release never replaces your proton-11. Each line is fetched from github.com/CachyOS/proton-cachyos and patched for ARM (removes the require_tool_appid line that otherwise makes Steam fail with "unable to launch the compatibility tool"), keeping the version you had per line as a one-press rollback copy. Downloads are verified and validated before they go live. Idempotent: skips any line already at its latest. Fully relaunch Steam afterwards.

game.name: Rollback Proton CachyOS
game.desc: Switches a Proton-CachyOS (ARM64) release line back to the version kept by "Update Proton CachyOS". When more than one line (10.x / 11.x) has a saved previous, it asks which line to roll back. If both a live and a previous version exist for that line it swaps them, so you can toggle back and forth; if only the saved one exists it restores it. The other line is left untouched. Use this if a freshly updated Proton-CachyOS misbehaves. Fully relaunch Steam afterwards.
